stationId.description: Client-supplied station identifier; re-using an existing one upserts capabilities.

locationCode.description: Optional facility-layout LocationCode identifying where this station physically sits (ADR-0024). Omitted entirely means unchecked — no role validation is attempted. When supplied and the location-role lookup is configured, a LocationCode that KNOWINGLY resolves to a role other than WorkCenter is rejected (422); an unrecognized LocationCode, or an unavailable lookup, fails open and is recorded unchecked.
